A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CPTC work and support comparison of the text, equations, tables, figures, and scientific appendices. The omitted NeurIPS checklist in v4 is an identifiable removal, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B report original forecasting experiments on three synthetic and three real-world datasets, including coverage, interval width, and ablation results.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix B retain original forecasting experiments and ablations, with revised numerical results in Tables 1, 4, and 5.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 retains the same state-specific calibration, adaptive coverage updates, and aggregation procedures in Equations 10–11. The problem-setting edits adjust notation and exposition without changing the method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Bouncing Ball obs., Bouncing Ball dyn., the 3-mode system, Electricity, Traffic, and Dancing Bees. The longer-stream and varying-noise scenarios already appear in v2 and remain in v4.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 5 retain RED-SDS, CP, ACI, SPCI, and HopCPT. Table 4 retains DtACI, ECI-cutoff, and L-ARC. Their numerical revisions do not change comparator membership.

E3.justification: The stated confidence target, coverage/width metrics, stream lengths, warm-start windows, splits, and training settings are unchanged. Neither PDF documents a protocol revision explaining the changed results.

E4.justification: Table 5 revises evidence in the existing long-stream and varying-noise robustness comparison: RED-SDS coverage on varying-observation-noise bouncing balls changes from 60.83% to 10.83%. The stress-test conditions and CPTC results remain unchanged, as do the state-error and aggregation ablations in Tables 2, 3, and 6 and the qualitative cases.

E5.justification: The mean-plus-standard-deviation reporting practice, including its definition over test samples in Tables 1 and 4, is retained. Seed information and uncertainty estimation procedures are unchanged; revised standard-deviation values are numerical result changes.

E6.justification: Substantial numerical revisions alter comparative findings under unchanged stated settings. Table 1 changes SPCI’s Bouncing Ball dyn. coverage from 53.62% to 89.16%. Table 4 changes DtACI’s Bouncing Ball obs. coverage from 82.97% to 92.45% and width from 3.21 to 1.06, while replacing CPTC entries to match Table 1. Table 5 changes RED-SDS’s Bouncing Ball obs. coverage from 89.31% to 18.53%.

T1.justification: The formal definitions, Proposition 4.1, Theorems 4.2–4.4, and Appendix A assumptions and proofs are unchanged. The runtime derivations are retained when Appendix C becomes B.6; the sequence-index edit does not revise mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The claimed contributions remain state-aware conformal prediction, validity and adaptation guarantees, and robust coverage across six datasets. The introduction’s switch from 'online' to 'state-of-the-art' baselines repeats framing already present in v2’s abstract and conclusion.

C2.justification: The added B.4 paragraph reiterates the explanation already in v2 Sections 5.1 and 6 that SPCI and HopCPT need more inference-time data, favoring CPTC on shorter streams. The limitations concerning unpredictable transitions, long-stream interval width, and dependence on a state predictor are retained.

D1.justification: The documented code repository changes from huiwenn/CPTC to Rose-STL-Lab/CPTC and is stated in the abstract. The removed checklist also removes its supplementary-code and release statements. Implementation, hyperparameter, hardware, and runtime disclosures otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same cited works and substantive research positioning are retained. The added comparison paragraph repeats existing positioning, and the UCI reference’s changed access date is bibliographic metadata only.

P1.justification: Most scientific prose remains verbatim. Local changes include problem-setting clarification, typo and funding edits, a reiterative B.4 paragraph, removal of the NeurIPS checklist, and relabeling runtime analysis from Appendix C to B.6.

P2.justification: All eight figures and six numbered tables are retained. Table 5 and Figures 7–8 move, Figures 6–7 now appear in numerical order, and runtime analysis is consolidated onto one page. Table 4’s validity highlighting changes with its results; figure content is unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 eliminates discrepancies between CPTC’s Tables 1 and 4 under matching stated settings; for example, Table 4’s Bouncing Ball obs. width changes from 10.70 to the 3.71 reported in Table 1. Appendix ordering also improves. These are limited, observable gains in consistency and presentation; the substantial baseline revisions remain unexplained and do not establish improved experimental rigor.
